title: Genies for Solar Project Closeout: Assemble Serial Numbers, Completion Evidence, and Handover Records
summary: Use Genies to prepare a solar project handover packet with traceable equipment and completion evidence.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


A solar project-closeout Genie can assemble equipment identifiers, approved scope, completion records and required handover documents into a review packet. Ask it to show the source and project association for every important item, distinguish installed equipment from ordered equipment, and identify missing evidence. It should not infer commissioning results, technical acceptance or customer approval. Project and technical owners validate the packet before customer handover or any related billing action.


Explore the complete[solar installation and o&m services integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/solar-installation-service) for the systems and processes around this guide.
